title: Split multi-invoice payments into separate rows in Excel report

requirements.summary: Split multi-invoice payment entries into individual rows in Excel export, duplicating payment details for each invoice
acceptanceCriteria: When a payment entry has multiple invoices (e.g., 'ABMNG-25-I102812, ABMNG-25-I104507'), each invoice appears on its own row in the exported CSV/Excel file
Payment details (date, retailer, salesman, type, mode, amount, transaction ID, bank, cheque number) are duplicated across all rows for that payment
The highlighted row example (ABMNG_D0553 with invoices ABMNG-25-I102812, ABMNG-25-I104507) exports as two separate rows with identical payment details but different invoice numbers
The invoice number column shows exactly one invoice number per row instead of comma-separated values

file_operations.description: Modify the exportReportsToXlsx function to iterate through each invoice number in the payment.invoiceNumbers array and create a separate CSV row for each invoice. Duplicate all payment details (payment date, retailer code, retailer name, salesman, payment type, payment mode, transaction ID, bank name, cheque number, amount) across all rows, but show only one invoice number per row. Replace the current logic that joins invoice numbers with commas into a single cell with a loop that generates one row per invoice while preserving all other payment details. Maintain the existing column order and formatting for single-invoice payments.
